title: Learning to Look Closer: A New Instance-Wise Loss for Small Cerebral Lesion Segmentation (CC-DiceCE)
mechanism: DiceCE computed per connected-component region (CC-Metrics), so each small object contributes its own term instead of being swamped by large ones.
adaptation: Per-component Dice + CE on crack (76-88% of crack components are < 20 px); optionally inactive. Targets the components-found metric and E1 crack recall.
min_experiment: Arm CE+Dice+CC-DiceCE(crack) vs SUP100, 5 v 5. Metric components >= 20 px found, crack IoU, relP@2; E1 relF1@2 secondary. Kill if components found < +0.02 or crack IoU drop > 0.012.
evidence: R: nnU-Net multi-dataset study; increases detection recall with minimal to no segmentation loss, dataset-dependent precision trade-off; generally beats blob loss (abstract).
prior_overlap: none (component-wise losses listed as untested in BRIEF section 5)

alt_notes.adaptation: Per-component Dice on crack (76-88% of components < 20 px) and inactive; component regions from the train labels with a 2 px dilation to absorb jitter.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house loss + CC-DiceCE on crack, 5 seeds; baseline SUP100. Metric components >= 20 px found, crack IoU, E1 recall. Kill: components found < +0.02 or crack IoU drop > 0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: Equal to BiCC alpha = 0 on merged crack and inactive instances; run as that arm. Recall bias suits E1; watch precision on test.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Run as BiCC alpha = 0 arm (see BiCC). Kill: component F1 below house or relP@2 drop > 0.03.
